scheme_name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS / TN OAP)
description: Social security pension scheme providing financial security to elderly destitute citizens belonging to Below Poverty Line (BPL) households.
benefits: Monthly pension of ₹1,000 per month deposited directly into the beneficiary's bank account.

eligibility_rules.description: Applicant must be 60 years of age or older
eligibility_rules.source: National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP) Guidelines, Ministry of Rural Development

eligibility_rules.description: Applicant must belong to a Below Poverty Line (BPL) household or be a destitute person with no regular means of financial support
eligibility_rules.source: TN Revenue Department Social Security Pension G.O.

required_documents: Age Proof (Birth Certificate / Voter ID / Aadhaar / Medical Board Certificate)
BPL Card / Income & Destitute Certificate issued by Tahsildar
application_method: Application submitted at local e-Sevai Center or Tahsildar Office (Social Security Scheme Wing) in Tamil Nadu.
source_document: Ministry of Rural Development NSAP Guidelines & TN Revenue Dept Guidelines
